title: adam aiken
text:
I am the Wesley R. Elingburg Professor in Business and Associate Professor of Finance at Elon University in Elon, NC.
My co-authors and I have published in the Journal of Financial Economics, the Review of Financial Studies, the Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, Management Science, the Journal of Corporate Finance, and Financial Review.
My SSRN page has the latest versions of our papers.






Our Elon Finance Faculty



     
Research Interests
Asset Management, Financial Institutions, Hedge Funds, Corporate Governance, Shareholder Activism
Courses Taught
During Fall semester, I teach the Trading and Markets elective that uses the trading simulation software developed at the Rotman School at Toronto University.
In the Spring semester, I teach Data Analysis in Finance using Python. Beyond the coding, I introduce students to “glue” concepts, such as git, terminal, and containers. I encourage students to use AI tools, while also using in-class, closed-note assignments as checks on comprehension. We also discuss finance theory and math throughout.
I teach our two-semester student managed portfolio course all year, where students run a real dollar portfolio. We use all of our available tools, such as Bloomberg and Factset, to manage the fund. In the first semester, we focus on valuation and idea generation, using ideas and texts from Aswath Damodaran and Michael Mauboussin. In the second semester, we focus more on portfolio management. The students will give their first presentation on the fund to the Elon community in the Spring of 2025.
Finally, I also regularly teach our advanced corporate finance course. This case-driven course covers topics such as project selection, equity valuation, and capital structure.
I have also taught investments, advanced investments, portfolio management, a CFA review, principles of finance, and financial modeling. I have experience teaching both R and Python.
I have taught versions of the above courses at both the undergraduate and MBA levels.
Education
Ph.D. in Finance from Arizona State University (2010)
Masters in Economics from Duke University (2005)
B.S. in Business Administration (Finance) from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (2000)
CFA Charterholder since 2003
